picks.why: Only candidate. It reads at once as a cowboy hat, with a soft matte finish and a simple band.
The solid star with a raised ring reads as a badge. Candidate 1's centre is punched through to the background, which breaks the object.
Smoother, chunkier leather and a truer foot-to-shaft proportion. Candidate 1 has a small foot and a grainier, more realistic surface.
Both are too photographic, but this one has a cleaner hinge, a proper spout and one dent. Candidate 1 has two dents and a fussier hinge and spout.
Chunky, simple toy form with the flower sitting properly on top, closest to the real cards' rounded volumes. Candidate 1 pinches at the base.
Pinned to the wall so it makes physical sense, sits upright and fills the card. Candidate 2 floats unattached and has placeholder dashes in its banner.
Truer barrel belly with a strong, frame-filling read. Candidate 2 is narrower and its rim looks stubbier.
Coherent perspective and porch structure with a clear false front and batwing doors. In candidate 1 the balcony rail cuts across the central window.
Whole wagon stays in frame with tall wheels and a clean bonnet. Candidate 2 crops the tongue at the edge and adds a strap.
The tank sits on a platform with a pipe, and the tail vane has a classic shape. Candidate 1's tank hangs unsupported inside the tower.
